name: Momentum Life Cycle Turnover Interaction
note: Lee-Swaminathan's momentum life cycle rebuilt as a within-name two-way sort, because the harness sees one symbol at a time: MOM is the form-bar return skipping the last skip bars, RVOL_LONGRUN is mean(volume over a short window) / mean(volume over a long window), and each is ranked against its OWN trailing distribution instead of against the cross-section. Long the top-momentum / bottom-relative-volume state (early-stage winner), short the bottom-momentum / top-relative-volume state (late-stage loser), rebalance every reb bars, hold exactly hold bars. The cross-sectional tercile sort and the shares-outstanding turnover cannot be reproduced from single-symbol OHLCV; the idea itself proposes the relative-volume substitute, and the time-series percentile is the honest stand-in for the tercile.
source: Lee, C.M.C. and Swaminathan, B. (2000), 'Price Momentum and Trading Volume', Journal of Finance 55(5) - https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/0022-1082.00280 ; international confirmation in 'Trading Volume and Momentum: The International Evidence'. PROXY NOTE from the idea: their turnover is volume/shares-outstanding, which we do not have; a within-name long-run relative volume ratio is substituted.
code:
def _pct_rank(hist, x):
    """Share of the trailing sample at or below x, in [0, 1]."""
    n = len(hist)
    if n < 20:
        return None
    k = 0
    for v in hist:
        if v <= x:
            k += 1
    return k / float(n)


def family_init(ctx):
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    v = [float(b.get("v") or 0.0) for b in bars]

    form = int(ctx.p.form)
    skip = int(ctx.p.skip)
    sw = int(ctx.p.rvol_short)
    lw = int(ctx.p.rvol_long)

    # prefix sums so the two volume means cost O(1) per bar
    ps = [0.0] * (n + 1)
    pd = [0.0] * (n + 1)
    for j in range(n):
        ps[j + 1] = ps[j] + v[j]
        pd[j + 1] = pd[j] + v[j] * c[j]

    mom = [None] * n
    rv = [None] * n
    dv = [None] * n
    for j in range(n):
        if j >= form and c[j - form] > 0:
            mom[j] = c[j - skip] / c[j - form] - 1.0
        if j >= lw:
            a = (ps[j + 1] - ps[j + 1 - sw]) / float(sw)
            b = (ps[j + 1] - ps[j + 1 - lw]) / float(lw)
            if b > 0:
                rv[j] = a / b
        if j >= 50:
            dv[j] = (pd[j + 1] - pd[j + 1 - 50]) / 50.0
    ctx.mom = mom
    ctx.rv = rv
    ctx.dv = dv
    ctx.p.time_stop = int(ctx.p.hold)


def signal(ctx, i):
    if i % int(ctx.p.reb) != 0:
        return 0
    m = ctx.mom[i]
    r = ctx.rv[i]
    if m is None or r is None:
        return 0
    d = ctx.dv[i]
    if d is not None and d < float(ctx.p.dv_min):
        return 0
    rw = int(ctx.p.rank_w)
    lo = max(0, i - rw)
    hm = [x for x in ctx.mom[lo:i] if x is not None]
    hr = [x for x in ctx.rv[lo:i] if x is not None]
    pm = _pct_rank(hm, m)
    pr = _pct_rank(hr, r)
    if pm is None or pr is None:
        return 0
    t = float(ctx.p.tiles)
    hi = 1.0 - 1.0 / t
    lo_ = 1.0 / t
    # early-stage winner: top momentum tercile, BOTTOM long-run relative volume
    if pm >= hi and pr <= lo_:
        return 1
    # late-stage loser: bottom momentum tercile, TOP long-run relative volume
    if pm <= lo_ and pr >= hi:
        return -1
    return 0
